description: This Java class defines a filter for reading headers where values of "JsonArray" serialization type are interpreted as comma-separated lists, converting them into JSON arrays. It is part of the 'protocol-adapter' module in the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: ReadJsonArrayHeadersFilter
classes.description: A filter class that interprets header values of JSON array serialization type as comma-separated lists, facilitating easier header value representation.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Creates and returns an instance of ReadJsonArrayHeadersFilter configured with the provided header definitions.

methods.name: filterValue
methods.description: Overrides a method to convert header values of JSON array type into their string representation.

methods.name: isJsonArrayDefinition
methods.description: Checks whether a given header key is defined as a JSON array type in the header definitions.

methods.name: getJsonArray
methods.description: Parses a header value into a JsonArray; if empty, returns an empty JsonArray.

search-terms: header entry filter in protocol adapter
